parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas en Google repiten lo mismo: cada board es distinto, la comunicacion es clara desde el primer mensaje y la presentacion deja a los invitados sorprendidos antes de probar el primer bocado.

texto.es: Fecha, numero de invitados, tema y cualquier restriccion alimentaria. Jos responde directo, a toda hora.
texto.en: Date, guest count, theme and any dietary needs. Jos answers directly, any time of day.

texto.es: Grazing board, carrito de charcuteria o mesa de postres, elegido segun tu evento y presupuesto.
texto.en: Grazing board, charcuterie cart or dessert table, chosen to fit your event and budget.

texto.es: Todo se arma el mismo dia con frutas, quesos y panes frescos, nunca con anticipacion.
texto.en: Everything is assembled the same day with fresh fruit, cheese and bread, never prepared in advance.

texto.es: Llegamos, montamos el display completo en tu locacion y lo dejamos listo para tus invitados.
texto.en: We arrive, set up the full display at your venue and leave it ready for your guests.

nota.es: Cada montaje se cotiza segun el numero de invitados y el tipo de evento. Llama y te da un precio claro.
nota.en: Every spread is quoted based on guest count and event type. Call and get a clear price.

texto.es: Tablas grandes de quesos, frutas, carnes y panes, disenadas para ser el centro de mesa del evento.
texto.en: Large boards of cheese, fruit, meats and bread, designed to be the centerpiece of the event.

texto.es: Un carrito movil con charcuteria y snacks, ideal para bodas y recepciones con espacio para circular.
texto.en: A mobile cart of charcuterie and snacks, perfect for weddings and receptions with room to mingle.

texto.es: Mesas tematicas con postres y decoracion floral, armadas a la medida del color y estilo de tu evento.
texto.en: Themed dessert tables with floral decor, built to match your event's colors and style.

texto.es: Spreads de brunch y charcuteria para bridal showers, baby showers y reuniones privadas.
texto.en: Brunch and charcuterie spreads for bridal showers, baby showers and private gatherings.

pie.es: ¿Tienes un evento diferente en mente? Escribenos igual, la mayoria de nuestros montajes empiezan como una idea a medida.
pie.en: Have a different kind of event in mind? Reach out anyway, most of our spreads start out as a custom idea.

items.quote: I've had the pleasure of working with Lo Monchi by Jos for several events, and every single grazing board has been a showstopper! Each one is completely unique, from the styles to the flavors, and you can truly taste the creativity and love that goes into every detail. They're almost too beautiful to eat... but way too good not to!

The catering was honestly one of the BEST experiences anyone could ask for! From the moment everything arrived, I was beyond impressed. The presentation was absolutely beautiful, the food was delicious.

Absolutely amazing! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every bite was delicious, and you can tell everything is made with love and quality ingredients. The portions were generous.
